svg.desc:
14 displayed observations: 9 PL R&D text-equivalent estimates included in the fit; 5 context marks excluded (2 paper-reported native task rates, 1 company native task rate and 2 unresolved image estimates). PL R&D text-equivalent estimates use an equiprobable 28-symbol modeling alphabet: 26 letters, a space and one extra symbol are our declared choice, not the actual task keyboard. log2(28) ≈ 4.8 assumed bits/character is an ideal finite-codebook equivalent, not measured English entropy or 8-bit storage (a literal fixed-width 28-symbol code needs 5 bits). Speech assumes five characters per word, including spaces: a normalization convention, not measured corpus word length. CPM × log2(28)/60; WPM × 5 × log2(28)/60. Calculations use full precision.
No extra WER/CER penalty: native correct-character rates already include correction time; the gross pace of speech and handwriting keeps reported errors separate. Vansteensel uses the reported 33 seconds/letter timing, not native correct CPM. Assistance and tasks differ: dictionary disambiguation, prediction, completion and language models can contribute to output. Correlations and language-model output mean these are not measured neural information rates, error-standardized results or a common performance benchmark.
Only 9 text-equivalent observations enter the fit; 5 context marks are excluded: 3 native task/company bits/s rates (unchanged) and 2 unresolved image estimates. All 14 marks retain reference-year placement. Bacher uses the 2015 issue (online 2014); Stentrode the 2021 issue (online 2020); home speech the 2025 preprint (final paper 2026). Named Bacher, Vansteensel and Milekovic/Sarma results are selections for our chart, not recovered original-dot assignments. Original image coordinates and historical candidate leads remain archived. Equal-weight ordinary least squares of log10(text-equivalent bits/s) against reference year across 9 converted-text observations; 5 context marks are excluded (3 native task-bps, 2 unresolved image estimates). log10(rate) = -0.587690 + 0.216845 × (year − 2015); R² in log10 space = 0.846969. Descriptive subset fit over 2015–2025 only; assistance, error metrics and tasks differ. Not a common performance benchmark, measured neural ITR, causal growth estimate or forecast. No confidence band is shown. Rings keep overlapping observations visible at their source positions. Qualified values (Text-equivalent / native-task context (bits/s · log)): Kennedy & Bakay: ≈0.24; Cursor control A · source unconfirmed: ≈0.9; Bacher et al.: ≈0.753; Vansteensel et al.: ≈0.146; Milekovic / Sarma et al.: ≈0.551; Synchron Stentrode: ≈0.46; Willett et al. · handwriting: ≈7.21; Moses & Chang: ≈6.09; Willett et al. · speech: ≈24.8; Metzger & Chang: ≈31.4; Card & Stavisky: ≈12.7; Card & Stavisky · home use: ≈22.5. Paper-reported · calculated · company · image estimate · Log scale · Unconnected observations 1. Kennedy & Bakay · 2000 · ≈0.24 bits/s · Image estimate · context · excluded from fit 2. Cursor control A · source unconfirmed · 2015 · ≈0.9 bits/s · Image estimate · context · excluded from fit 3. Bacher et al. · 2015 · ≈0.753 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 9.4±3.2 correct CPM × log2(28)/60 · completion off; dictionary disambiguation · fit included 4. Vansteensel et al. · 2016 · ≈0.146 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 33 s/letter; timing output → log2(28)/33 · prediction on; ECoG scanning · fit included 5. Milekovic / Sarma et al. · 2018 · ≈0.551 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 6.88±0.33 correct CPM × log2(28)/60 · completion on; FlashSpeller scanning · fit included 6. Pandarinath et al. · T5 9×9 grid · 2017 · 4.16 bits/s · Paper-reported · context · excluded from fit 7. Neuralink PRIME · 2024 · 8 bits/s · Company-reported · context · excluded from fit 8. Synchron Stentrode · P2 isolated · 2021 · ≈0.46 bits/s · Paper-reported estimate · context · excluded from fit 9. Willett et al. · handwriting · 2021 · ≈7.21 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 90 gross CPM × log2(28)/60; 5.4% CER · no LM postprocessing · fit included 10. Moses & Chang · 2021 · ≈6.09 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 15.2 gross WPM × 5 × log2(28)/60; 25.6% WER · LM-assisted · fit included 11. Willett et al. · speech · 2023 · ≈24.8 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 62 gross WPM × 5 × log2(28)/60; 23.8% WER · LM-assisted · fit included 12. Metzger & Chang · 2023 · ≈31.4 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 78.3 gross WPM × 5 × log2(28)/60; 25.5% WER · LM-assisted · fit included 13. Card & Stavisky · 2024 · ≈12.7 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 31.6 gross WPM × 5 × log2(28)/60; 2.5% WER · LM-assisted · fit included 14. Card & Stavisky · home use · 2025 · ≈22.5 bits/s text-equivalent · PL R&D estimate · 56.1 gross WPM × 5 × log2(28)/60; WER unpaired · LM-assisted · fit included Kennedy & Bakay · 2000 · reference-year placement; source date below. Image estimate. Reported input: Approximately 0.24 bits/s from the reference image; native numeric result unresolved. Image digitization only; no text conversion or verified source-native rate. Reference image: approximately 0.24 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2000 (paper publication year). The paper is identified at metadata/abstract level; its full numerical result is unverified. No typing-rate conversion is used for this dot. Context; excluded from fit. Cursor control A · source unconfirmed · 2015 · reference-year placement; source date below. Image estimate. Approximately 0.9 bits/s, digitized from the reference. The papers below are plausible candidates, not confirmed assignments; this dot has not been replaced by a converted candidate result. Context; excluded from fit. Bacher et al. · 2015 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 9.4 ± 3.2 correct characters/minute; radial ‘keyboard ’ condition, completion off; ambiguous-key disambiguation retained (not the 10.4-CPM completion condition). 9.4 correct characters/minute × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60. No extra error penalty: correct CPM already accounts for correction. Completion is off; ambiguous-key disambiguation remains. Reference image: approximately 0.76 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2014-11-10 (first online publication; 2015 journal issue). Explicitly selected paper-backed observation for this chart, not a confirmed assignment of the original author's dot. Text-equivalent; fit included. Vansteensel et al. · 2016 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 33 seconds/letter with prediction assistance (= 60/33 characters/minute), rather than the rounded two letters/minute summary. (60/33) characters/minute × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60 = log2(28)/33 bits/s. Gross output pace with prediction assistance. No error penalty; no extra WER/CER factor. Reference image: approximately 0.16 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2016-11-12 (first online publication). Explicitly selected paper-backed observation for this chart, not a confirmed assignment of the original author's dot. Text-equivalent; fit included. Milekovic / Sarma et al. · 2018 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 6.88 ± 0.33 correct characters/minute, T6 free spelling with word completion using FlashSpeller neural-switch scanning. 6.88 correct characters/minute × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60. No extra error penalty: correct CPM already accounts for correction. Word completion remains part of the task. Reference image: approximately 0.53 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2018-04-25 (first online publication). Explicitly selected paper-backed observation for this chart, not a confirmed assignment of the original author's dot. Text-equivalent; fit included. Pandarinath et al. · 2017 · reference-year placement; source date below. Paper-reported. Reported input: 4.16 ± 0.39 bits/s, T5 9×9 grid; mean across eight blocks/two days. Native task bits/s retained as reported; not converted using the text convention. Reference image: approximately 3.5 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2017-02-21 (paper publication). The paper also reports 3.7 ± 0.4 bits/s for T5 on a 6×6 grid. The chart explicitly selects the 9×9 mean, not the single 4.36-bits/s example block; the original figure's exact choice is unknown. Context; excluded from fit. Neuralink PRIME · 2024 · reference-year placement; source date below. Company-reported. Reported input: 8.0 bits/s achieved Webgrid performance, Neuralink's May 8, 2024 update; not a peer-reviewed paper. Native task bits/s retained as reported; not converted using the text convention. Reference image: approximately 8.7 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2024-05-08 (company disclosure). This is a company disclosure, not independent validation. The original figure's exact value/date/grid pairing is unknown. Context; excluded from fit. Synchron Stentrode · 2021 · reference-year placement; source date below. Paper-reported estimate. Reported input: 0.46 bits/s, participant 2 mean estimated isolated motor-neuroprosthesis contribution. Actual typing also used eye tracking; this is the authors' isolated-contribution estimate, not the hybrid 1.57-bits/s result. Native task bits/s retained as reported; not converted using the text convention. Reference image: approximately 0.47 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2020-10-28 (online publication; February 2021 journal issue). The isolated contribution is an author estimate; actual typing used eye tracking. Participant 1's isolated estimate was 0.32 bits/s. Context; excluded from fit. Willett et al. · handwriting · 2021 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 90 characters/minute with 5.4% character error rate on the final evaluation day, from Willett et al. 2021. 90 characters/minute × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60. PL R&D code-equivalent estimate of gross decoding pace, not measured neural ITR. No error penalty; 5.4% CER remains separate. Reference image: approximately 6.6 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2021-05-12 (first online publication; issue 2021-05-13). The final-day 5.4% character error rate is distinct from the overall five-day 94.1% accuracy. The selected 90-CPM gross pace is converted by PL R&D without a CER penalty; no author corrected-typing model is used. Text-equivalent; fit included. Moses & Chang · 2021 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 15.2 words/minute; real-time visually prompted sentence decoding, language model enabled. 25.6% word error rate. 15.2 words/minute × 5 assumed characters/word × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60. PL R&D code-equivalent estimate of gross decoding pace, not measured neural ITR. No error penalty; the reported error metric remains separate. Reference image: approximately 1.2 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2021-07-14 (first online publication; issue 2021-07-15). Prompted sentences with a language model and a restricted 50-word vocabulary. WPM and WER are source-level medians with different aggregation, not a per-trial channel estimate. Text-equivalent; fit included. Willett et al. · speech · 2023 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 62 words/minute; real-time held-out prompted sentences. 23.8% word error rate. 62 words/minute × 5 assumed characters/word × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60. PL R&D code-equivalent estimate of gross decoding pace, not measured neural ITR. No error penalty; the reported error metric remains separate. Reference image: approximately 4.9 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2023-08-23 (first online publication). The 23.8% WER applies to the 125,000-word vocalized condition; the paper's 9.1% WER belongs to a separate 50-word condition. Evaluation used held-out prompted sentences, not free conversation. Text-equivalent; fit included. Metzger & Chang · 2023 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 78.3 words/minute; real-time text decoding of held-out silently attempted prompted sentences. 25.5% word error rate. 78.3 words/minute × 5 assumed characters/word × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60. PL R&D code-equivalent estimate of gross decoding pace, not measured neural ITR. No error penalty; the reported error metric remains separate. Reference image: approximately 6.2 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2023-08-23 (first online publication). Online evaluation used 1,024 words. The 39,378-word condition was an offline simulation; a later anatomical correction did not change real-time decoding performance. Text-equivalent; fit included. Card & Stavisky · 2024 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 31.6 words/minute; prompted copy task at self-paced speaking rate. 2.5% word error rate. 31.6 words/minute × 5 assumed characters/word × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60. PL R&D code-equivalent estimate of gross decoding pace, not measured neural ITR. No error penalty; the reported error metric remains separate. Reference image: approximately 2.6 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2024-08-14 (first online publication; issue 2024-08-15). 31.6 WPM and 2.5% WER are the final five copy-task session means. The reference figure's 33-WPM label is a different, unverified selection. Text-equivalent; fit included. Card & Stavisky · home use · 2025 · reference-year placement; source date below. PL R&D estimate. Reported input: 56.1 words/minute; unconstrained personal use at home. 56.1 words/minute × 5 assumed characters/word × log2(28) bits/character ÷ 60. PL R&D code-equivalent estimate of gross decoding pace, not measured neural ITR. No error penalty; the reported error metric remains separate. Reference image: approximately 4.4 bits/s; original image coordinates remain archived separately. Publication/disclosure: 2025-07-07 (bioRxiv v1 posting, not DOI date string; peer-reviewed online publication 2026-06-15). Personal home use has no paired WER here. The 99.2% copy-task accuracy and 92.3% participant-rated sentence correctness are different endpoints. This follows the same participant as Card 2024, not an independent cohort. Text-equivalent; fit included. Sources: Identified report; numerical value unresolved: Direct control of a computer from the human central nervous system; Anonymous reference-image mark · assignment unresolved; Reported input: Neural point-and-click communication by a person with incomplete locked-in syndrome; Reported input: Fully Implanted Brain–Computer Interface in a Locked-In Patient with ALS; Reported input: Stable long-term BCI-enabled communication in ALS and locked-in syndrome using LFP signals; Paper-reported: High performance communication by people with paralysis using an intracortical brain-computer interface; Company-reported: PRIME Study Progress Update — User Experience (company report); Paper-reported estimate: Motor neuroprosthesis implanted with neurointerventional surgery improves capacity for activities of daily living tasks in severe paralysis; Reported input: High-performance brain-to-text communication via handwriting; Reported input: Neuroprosthesis for Decoding Speech in a Paralyzed Person with Anarthria; Reported input: A high-performance speech neuroprosthesis; Reported input: A high-performance neuroprosthesis for speech decoding and avatar control; Reported input: An Accurate and Rapidly Calibrating Speech Neuroprosthesis; Reported input: Long-term independent use of an intracortical brain-computer interface for speech and cursor control
